subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'RECOVERY' is written as 'YRFVPCFR' and 'REQUIRED' is written as 'DFRJVQFR'. How will 'RIGOROUS' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'RECOVERY' is written as 'YRFVPCFR',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39bccfa97c226558c998ee7ef9ed71ff798975b750dfc54bbb595ff05524197a.png] 

‘REQUIRED' is written as 'DFRJVQFR’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dafc012654cb44ac8d7bd6a45c636d310b46f2bdd01681465a5b0d59bf096d70.png] 

Similarly, for 'RIGOROUS'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f49e4394608237714e56379cb7aa19d2909a983c92aa33066a32cd635576c960.png] 

So, '**RIGOROUS**' will be written as '**SVPRPGJR**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
